ui_bugs.issue: Inner sidebar container (Chat.tsx:756) 'flex h-full flex-col border-r ... bg-[hsl(var(--sidebar-background)))]' is missing w-full, so as a row-flex child it shrink-wraps to ~287px inside its 390px (mobile) / 384px (desktop lg:w-96) outer wrapper. Result: ~103px dead black strip right of the sidebar content at 390x844 (inbox is NOT full-screen despite the code comment 'sidebar: full-screen on mobile'), and a ~97px black gap between sidebar content and main pane at 1280x800. PRE-EXISTING: identical markup in base branch feat/locat-1.0, so not a regression of this dialog round, but it fails Stage 6 responsive intent. Verified fix: adding w-full makes inner width 389px at 390 viewport.

rca_of_issue: Sidebar gap RCA: inbox appeared ~285px wide with a black strip at 390x844 and a black band between sidebar and chat at 1280x800. Measurements: outer wrapper (Chat.tsx:923, 'w-full md:w-80 lg:w-96') correctly 390px/384px, but its only child — the inner sidebar container (Chat.tsx:756, 'flex h-full flex-col border-r ... bg-[hsl(var(--sidebar-background))]') — is a row-flex item with no w-full/flex-1, so it shrink-wraps to content width (~287px). The outer wrapper has no background, so the uncovered area shows the near-black page background. Confirmed pre-existing: identical class list in base branch feat/locat-1.0 (not a regression of the feat/emergent-ui redesign rounds). Fix verified live via devtools: adding w-full -> inner width 389px at 390 viewport, strip gone.
